title: The Tune at the Gate  (A melodia no portão)

segments.t: Hannah corre até o portão aberto do pátio com Arthur e Evelyn, chamando com simpatia o vizinho mais velho que estava ouvindo na Linden Street. Ouça primeiro.
Excuse me, sir—would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
Wait... our neighbour from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait—look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes—he said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin—and ten neighbours from down the street!
Ten extra neighbours?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
Agora vamos revisar linha por linha com a tradução em português.
Excuse me, sir—would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
'Com licença, senhor — gostaria de entrar para tomar uma xícara quentinha de chá?'

'Espere... nosso vizinho da loja de violinos no número dez?!'
You know each other, Arthur?!
'Vocês se conhecem, Arthur?!'
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
'Trinta anos atrás, ele trazia o violino dele para cá toda sexta-feira às seis!'
Wait—look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
'Esperem — olhem nosso cartão-postal antigo: "Guardem duas cadeiras para a padeira e o professor"!'
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
'Ele era o professor de música que tocava duetos de sexta-feira com a sua tia!'
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
'Ele acabou de me perguntar quem finalmente terminou a segunda metade da valsa de maio dela!'
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
'O que ele disse quando ouviu meus dezesseis compassos pela janela, Arthur?'
He had tears in his eyes—he said it sounded just like her voice!
'Ele tinha lágrimas nos olhos — disse que parecia exatamente com a voz dela!'
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
'Você o convidou para a nossa grande inauguração nesta sexta-feira às seis horas?!'
He promised to bring his violin—and ten neighbours from down the street!
'Ele prometeu trazer o violino — e dez vizinhos lá de baixo da rua!'
Ten extra neighbours?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
'Dez vizinhos a mais?! A Tessa vai precisar do dobro de limões até sexta-feira!'
Agora vamos ouvir a conversa inteira uma última vez.

O parceiro de duetos das sextas-feiras de trinta anos atrás ouviu pela janela aberta e vai trazer o violino — e metade da rua — de volta nesta sexta às seis! O Episódio 5 está completo — nos vemos no final da Temporada 2.
